LanguageData.CC_Landing_MenuTip: Start again on a new map with the same people, animals and what is left of the starting kit, in the same world, with the same ideology, storyteller and research. Offered for {DAYS} days after a landing.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_CardTip: The same colony on a new map: a new map of this place, or another place on the world map. Only in a new game's first days.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Off: Rimfolk's deeper game hooks are off in its settings.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_NotSeen: Only in a new game whose start Rimfolk saw.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Over: Only in the first {DAYS} days after a landing.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Gravship: The colony came by gravship, and the gravship itself can fly it to another place.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Space: Not for a start above the planet.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Homes: Only while the colony has one home, the map it landed on.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Monolith: The void monolith has woken, and what it holds is bound to this map.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Away: Not while some of the colony are away from the map: {NAMES}.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Borrowed: those lent out for a quest
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Inside: Not while some of the colony are inside something on the map, a casket, a pod or a vat: {NAMES}.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_No_Threat: Not while a threat is on the map.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Pick_Here: That is where the colony is now: choose a new map of the same place for it.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Pick_Layer: Only a place on the same layer of the world as the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Forced: The scenario chose this place, so only a new map of it can be made.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Subtitle: A new map for {PEOPLE}, in the same world. Everything else stays as it is.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_SamePlace: A new map of the same place
LanguageData.CC_Landing_SamePlaceTip: The same tile of the world, with its land, hills, river and road, laid out anew.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_OtherPlaceTip: A tile you pick on the world map. The colony's settlement moves there, with its name.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_ComesGear: Everything they wear, wield and carry comes with them.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_ComesKit: From the starting kit, what lies on this map: {LIST}.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_ComesKitNone: Nothing of the starting kit lies loose on this map now.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Arrive_Pods: They come down in drop pods near the new map's start spot, as at the game's start, with the kit that came with them.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Arrive_Standing: They start at the new map's start spot, as at the game's start, with the kit that came with them beside them.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_ArriveScatter: What the scenario scattered near the start lies near the new one, and what it scattered anywhere lies anywhere.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Lost: Everything built, sown or made on this map, and whatever else lies on it: walls, floors and zones, fields and stockpiles, the stores and what was hunted, cut or mined. Visitors, wild animals and anyone else not of the colony stay with this map.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Stays: The world, the ideology, the storyteller, the research, the colony's relations with every people and Rimfolk's records of the colony stay as they are. The date goes on from today.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_OfferLine: Offered for {DAYS} days after a landing, and for {DAYS} days again after each landing chosen here.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Long: Making the new map. The same people, animals and starting kit come along.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Done_tribal: The tribe begins again at {NAME}, in the {LAND}, on a new map: the same people, beasts and what is left of what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Done_medieval: The settlers begin again at {NAME}, in the {LAND}, on a new map: the same people, animals and what is left of what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Done_industrial: The colony starts again at {NAME}, in the {LAND}, on a new map: the same people, animals and what is left of the starting kit.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Done_spacer: The colony starts again at {NAME}, in the {LAND}, on a new map: the same people, machines, animals and what is left of the starting kit.
LanguageData.CC_Landing_Failed: The new map could not be made, so the colony starts again at {NAME}, where it was, on a new map of that place.
